parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The DTS instance ID. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ETL task ID. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the instance status list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings this parameter for paging. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the DTS instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query available regions.
